state: The baseline scenario was determined for the first baseline period as industrial forestry (typically planting monoculture acacia) plantation and remains the most credible scenario for the second baseline period.

The project overcomes these barriers through community conservation training, sustainable livelihoods, ecological monitoring systems, and legal support. Without carbon finance or similar performance-based payments, these interventions would not be viable.
Furthermore, project activities rely on carbon finance to be implemented. Without the Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) mechanism and associated revenues, the project would not be financially viable.

Additionality was demonstrated for the first baseline period (see PT. Rimba Makmur Utama 2016), and the project is therefore additional for its entire lifetime, not requiring a full additionality assessment for the baseline renewal.

The total uncertainty error in the project was calculated to be 2.44%. Considering the 15% uncertainty threshold, no VCU deductions were made due to uncertainty.

As there was no leakage during the previous baseline period, it is assumed that no leakage will occur. Actual leakage will be monitored throughout the project crediting period and will be reported at each monitoring event.

This stratum is maintained in the baseline on a precautionary and conservative basis, resulting in a larger protected area than the current regulatory minimum requires and thereby reducing rather than inflating baseline emissions.
